text:
Expense/Receipt Tracking Grok Bot template

Snap a photo or forward your emailed receipt to a dedicated inbox and have @bot create a spreadsheet on your Google Drive along with links to the receipts stored on Drive broken out by month/year. 

Multiple receipts in a single image are broken out into individual images. 
https://x.ai/bot/qod4CrNQBlDIMm5wFYVQp
